entry.name: jit.fx.brcosa
entry.description: Permits you to simultaneously adjust an image's brightness, contrast and saturation. This is useful for achieving a variety of color effects.

attributes.name: adapt
attributes.digest: Adapt output dims to input
attributes.description: Adapt output dims to input (default = 1). When enabled the output dimensions will match the leftmost input dimensions.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: brightness
attributes.digest: Brightness
attributes.description: Brightness (default = 1.) Values below 1. (to 0.) reduce brightness, while values above 1. increase it. 1. represents no change.

attributes.name: bypass
attributes.digest: Bypass effect processing
attributes.description: Bypass effect processing flag (default = 0). When enabled the input is passed through to the output without processing.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: contrast
attributes.digest: Contrast
attributes.description: Contrast (default = 1.) Values below 1. (to 0.) decrease contrast, bringing the image closer to grey (which represents the average luminance of the image frame). Values above 1.0 increase contrast. 1.0 represents no change. Negative values affect a color inversion, but with similar results.

attributes.name: dim
attributes.digest: Output texture dimensions
attributes.description: The output texture dimensions. Whenis enabled this will be set automatically to the leftmost input.
